---
title: "Trial Results"
---

All pre-specified and pre-programmed trial results from day 0 to day 28 are available in Tables, Listings and Figures (TLF) books. 
Long term follow-up (until 6 months after baseline) will be presented separately.

1. Primary Publication: 
This TLF-book documents all summaries and statistical analyses for safety and efficacy endpoints presented in the primary publication as documented in the SAP and trial protocol. This version is archived in a [Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23350243) and available [here](tlf-book-pp/latest/index.html) in its latest version. The results will be released and the links become active upon publication of the primary paper. Password-protected access for reviewers is provided [here](https://dexa-psych.netlify.app/) until the primary publication is published.

1. Clinical Trial Protocol (CTR): This TLF-book includes additional pre-specified and pre-programmed secondary endpoints.
This version of the TLF-book is archived in a [Zenodo DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23349388) and will be released upon publication of the secondary outcomes.
